reason: Six hundred euros up front plus fifteen every month, and nobody can tell me how many direct bookings it brings. My guests already find me on Booking and message me on WhatsApp, so I'd be paying for a nice page that maybe pays back next year, maybe never.
objection: €600 is a lot when I don't know if it brings any bookings. And the monthly fee never stops, even in winter when nobody books.
would_change_my_mind: If they took a smaller deposit and the rest only after the site brought me a few direct bookings, or showed me a villa owner nearby who saved more than €600 in Booking commission in one season with it.
